newsitem.title: USA: Data Dimensions gets $10 mln in business.
newsitem.headline: Data Dimensions gets $10 mln in business.

text.p: Data Dimensions Inc said Wednesday that over the past 12 weeks it has received roughly $10 million worth of business related to its new Millenium consulting technology.
Millenium is part of Data Dimension's Year 2000 group of products and services that help companies prepare computer systems for the year 2000, when many computer clocks must be reset.

Data Dimensions said a new product, Ardes 2K, is getting good feedback from companies testing it. Priced at $3,000 per unit, Ardes 2K is a CD-ROM and Internet product that gives information and solutions for year 2000 problems.
